title: DeDiCa: A Scalable Deconfounding Discrete Causal Generative Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.23272v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce DeDiCa, a practical framework for efficient causal inference with discrete variables and hidden confounding that revisits classical probabilistic modeling through a tensorized parameterization of causal Bayesian networks, enabling tractable inference. Given a causal graph, DeDiCa is trained once on observational data by maximum likelihood, exactly marginalizing over hidden confounders, and can then estimate any (proxy-)identifiable interventional query. Despite this deliberately simple parameterization, DeDiCa matches state-of-the-art neural causal generative models in ATE estimation, while supporting memory-efficient CPU training and exact interventional inference in milliseconds. Compared with causal foundation models, DeDiCa scales more effectively with additional observational samples and achieves competitive accuracy at substantially lower inference time and memory. translated_title: DeDiCa：一种可扩展的去混杂离散因果生成模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DeDiCa，一个面向离散变量和隐藏混杂因素的高效因果推断实用框架。该框架通过因果贝叶斯网络的张量化参数化重新审视经典概率建模，使推断变得可处理。给定一个因果图，DeDiCa只需在观测数据上通过最大似然训练一次，对隐藏混杂因素进行精确边缘化，之后即可估计任何（代理）可识别的干预查询。尽管参数化设计有意保持简洁，DeDiCa在平均处理效应（ATE）估计方面可与最先进的神经因果生成模型相媲美，同时支持内存高效的CPU训练和毫秒级的精确干预推断。与因果基础模型相比，DeDiCa在观测样本增多时扩展性更强，并以显著更低的推断时间和内存实现了具有竞争力的准确度。DeDiCa为因果推断提供了一个可处理、准确且可扩展的方案。
tldr: DeDiCa通过张量化参数化的因果贝叶斯网络，实现了对含隐藏混杂的离散变量高效且可扩展的因果推断，其精度媲美最先进的神经因果生成模型，同时推理速度和内存开销大幅降低。
en_tdlr: DeDiCa enables efficient, scalable causal inference for discrete variables with hidden confounding via a tensorized causal Bayesian network parameterization, matching state-of-the-art neural causal generative models in accuracy while being dramatically faster and more memory-efficient.
